messages.subject: Widening participation scholarship applications now being accepted for introductory workshop
parts:
The introductory distance sampling training workshop will be offered 11-22 April 2022 via video conferencing (1500-1730UK time).  To encourage wide participation in this workshop, we will again be offering a scholarship place.  Applications are now being accepted for this "widening participation scholarship", application details can be found at this webpage:
http://workshops.distancesampling.org/widening-participation

Application deadline for scholarships to attend the April introductory workshop is 11 February 2022.  If you have questions, feel free to contact me.

Registration for the April introductory workshop will open the week of 14Feb22.  Details for the April workshop can be found at
http://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-apr-22.html

Eric Rexstad

Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling

University of St Andrews
